extracted.intended_audience: recording artists, producers, engineers, album compilers, record labels, and GRAMMY entrants/submission teams
extracted.subtask_description: Official GRAMMY Award category definitions and eligibility requirements describing what each category recognizes, entry eligibility conditions (language, percentage thresholds, release timing, format), nominee identification, and who receives statuettes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Contemporary Christian Music Album
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes excellence in a solo, duo, group, or collaborative performance of Contemporary Christian Music, including pop, rap/hip-hop, Latin, and rock.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recordings of sermons are eligible in Best Audio Book, Narration And Storytelling Recording. Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Roots Gospel Album
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes excellence in a solo, duo, group, or collaborative performance of traditional/roots gospel music, including country, Southern gospel, bluegrass, and Americana.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recordings of sermons are eligible in Best Audio Book, Narration And Storytelling Recording. Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Latin Pop Album
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes excellence in Latin music recordings that utilize a stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content, and/or musical presentation to create a sensibility that reflects the broad spectrum of Latin pop and urban music styles and culture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes balladeers and commercial Latin music; not limited to any one region and inclusive of international sound and romantic ballad. Albums with greater than 50% Spanish language lyrics or albums with music content that is primarily of a Latin genre in style (excluding Brazilian music) are eligible. Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Música Urbana Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Best Música Urbana Album encompasses music greater than 50% Spanish lyrics, originating in reggaeton and other Latin urban styles, including rap, house, R&B, trap, and others.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Latin Rock or Alternative Album
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes excellence in Latin rock or alternative music recordings that utilize a stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content, and/or musical presentation to create a sensibility that reflects the broad spectrum of the Latin music style and culture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Albums with greater than 50% Spanish language lyrics or albums with music content that is primarily of a Latin genre in style (excluding Brazilian music) are eligible. Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Música Mexicana Album (Including Tejano)
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes excellence in recordings of Música Mexicana including all the styles (banda, norteño, corridos, gruperos, mariachi, rancheros, sierreño, jarocho, huasteco, huapango) as well as Tejano music.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible albums utilize stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content and/or musical presentation to reflect the broad spectrum of música Mexicana and Tejano styles and cultures. Albums with greater than 50% Spanish language lyrics or albums with music content that is primarily of a traditional Mexican music genre in style are eligible. The musical style is determinative, not the ethnicity of the performer(s). Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Tropical Latin Album
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes excellence in tropical Latin music recordings, including traditional and contemporary tropical styles like salsa, merengue, vallenato, cumbia, and bachata.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Albums that utilize stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content, and/or musical presentation to reflect the broad spectrum of tropical Latin music style and culture are eligible. Category houses all tropical genres. Albums with greater than 50% Spanish language lyrics or albums with music content that is primarily of a Latin genre in style (excluding Brazilian music) are eligible. Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Global Music Performance
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category is intended for vocal and instrumental performances with strong elements of global cultural significance that blend pop, R&B, dance, rap, and folk with unique music forms, local expressions and techniques originating outside the United States.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The combination should give a unique sense of melody, rhythm, harmony, and lyric that is of global appeal. Nominees are Artist(s). GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Best African Music Performance
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligible recordings include vocal and instrumental performances with strong elements of African cultural significance that blend stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content and/or musical representation found in Africa and the African Diaspora.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The African Diaspora defined as worldwide communities descended from native Africans or people from Africa. Nominees are Artist(s). GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Global Music Album
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes excellence in albums of global music that incorporate global music elements uniquely found beyond traditional U.S. conventions or styles including unique local expressions from across the globe.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focuses on excellence and quality of recordings and performances independent of a particular genre. Albums of reggae, Latin or European pop music are not eligible and should be entered in other Categories. Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Reggae Album
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes excellence in albums of reggae music, including roots reggae, dancehall and ska music.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best New Age, Ambient or Chant Album
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category may incorporate elements from diverse genres to serve artistic intentions and functional uses (textural atmospheric journeys, soundscapes for relaxation/meditation/focus, wellness, devotional offerings) and can include sacred or secular components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Music may be improvisational, exploratory, textural, or structurally composed and may be consonant, dissonant, contemplative, dynamic, or avant-garde. Vocal music and solo/multi-instrumentals welcome. Recordings may incorporate acoustic, synthesized or environmental sounds; includes environmental recordings (where the recordist is the artist). Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Children's Music Album
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes excellence in children’s music recordings that utilize stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content and/or musical presentation to reflect the broad spectrum of children’s music.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Albums must be created and intended specifically for children; lyrics and English language translations are required with entry submissions. All children’s music recordings belong in this Category including those rooted in Latin, gospel, rock, rap, etc. Instrumental-only albums must show stylistic intention, song structure, content or presentation reflecting children’s music. 'Children' defined as infant to twelve years old. Children’s spoken word albums eligible in Spoken Word Poetry Album and Best Audio Book, Narration, and Storytelling Recording. Soundtrack albums of children’s movies eligible in Best Compilation Soundtrack For Visual Media. Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Comedy Album
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes excellence in comedy recordings, including spoken word stand-up comedy and musical/novelty recordings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: New comedy performance albums (studio or live, audio-only or part of a video project) are eligible. Compilations/excerpts from a current year radio/television program, or new recordings of comedy performance first aired on television within five years of the release date are eligible. Compilations/excerpts from non-current year broadcast radio/TV programs, audio books (even if humorous), albums of sound effects, and albums of environmental recordings are not eligible in this Category and may be entered in other Categories. Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Audio Book, Narration and Storytelling Recording
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes excellence in spoken word albums (not including Spoken Word Poetry): audio books, storytelling, non-musical drama, sermons, narrations with or without music collaboration or accompaniment, and instructional recordings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The performing narrator or storyteller is the Nominee. If primarily spoken work with musical accompaniment, the narrator is eligible while musical accompanists may be identified but are not nominees. Recordings that accompany children’s picture books eligible if recorded content is non-repetitive and meets album entry requirements. Recordings that feature song lyrics that are spoken or rapped are eligible in appropriate genre Categories. Incidental talk or conversation used as an accent to a musical recording does not constitute a spoken work performance. Compilations or excerpts of previously broadcast radio/TV shows, albums of sound effects, and albums of environmental recordings are not eligible. Nominees are Spoken Word Narrator or Storytelling Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Spoken Word Narrator or Storytelling Artist(s), Producer(s) & Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Compilation Soundtrack for Visual Media
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes excellence in soundtrack compilation albums comprised predominantly of song or non-original instrumental compositions created specifically for or as a companion to a current legitimate motion picture, television show or series, video game, or other visual media production.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Albums must be greater than 50% song compilation and may include previously released material. At least two-thirds of the musical tracks on the album must have been used in the visual media. Eligible soundtrack for a documentary/biopic/combined work must contain 50% or more newly recorded music. Category placement determined by the predominant nature of newly recorded music (song or score) featured in the visual medium. For television soundtracks, greater than 50% of playing time must derive from new episodes/programming that airs during the GRAMMY eligibility year. Configurations not meeting general eligibility (e.g., DVDs or video games that contain music but are not available as stand-alone audio streams/releases) are not eligible. Live concert films, live or filmed stage shows, musical/variety/reality television shows, musical documentaries focused primarily on live performance or 'making of' works, and soundtrack albums that are greatest hits/career retrospectives are not eligible. For albums/songs released during the current eligibility period but whose visual media will be released in the next eligibility period, entrants have options: (1) enter during current year in other Categories (will not be eligible next year in Music For Visual Media Field), or (2) enter the following year as long as not entered in any Category during current year (albums eligible only in Compilation or Score; songs eligible in Song Written For Visual Media and other song Categories if they fulfill track-from-previous-year rule). Nominees are Principal Artist(s) with significant contributing performances, and/or in-studio Producer(s) of a majority of the tracks on the album. Up to two album Producers and Music Supervisors are eligible. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Principal Artist(s) with significant contributing performances and/or in-studio Producers of a majority of the tracks; in absence of those, award to individual(s) responsible for concept/musical direction and selection of artists, songs and producers. For albums largely of pre-existing masters, up to two album Producers and up to two Music Supervisors are eligible. For albums consisting largely of new recordings, awards to Principal Artist(s) with significant contributing performance(s) (ensemble-driven casts where performers have comparable participation are not eligible); up to three Producer(s) (extraordinary appeals for possible fourth considered); up to two Music Supervisors. Engineer/Mixer(s) of greater than 50% playing time of newly recorded material are eligible for awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Score Soundtrack for Visual Media
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes excellence in score soundtrack albums comprised predominantly of original score and created specifically for, or as a companion to, a current legitimate motion picture, television show or series or other visual media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: At least two-thirds of the musical tracks on the album must have been used in the motion picture, television show or series. Greater than 50% of the music on an otherwise eligible television soundtrack must be derived from new episodes/new programming that airs during the GRAMMY eligibility year. Eligible orchestrations may include vocal coloring (not songs). Greater than 50% of the music on an otherwise eligible Video Game or Interactive Media soundtrack must be derived from new episodes/new programming released during the GRAMMY eligibility year (applies to DLC and seasonal expansions). Soundtracks of live concert films, live or filmed stage shows, and certain musical documentaries are not eligible. Albums/songs released during the current eligibility period but belonging to visual media released next year have options (enter current year in other Categories, enter following year if not entered this year, or timing rule for media released before soundtrack). Nominees are Composer(s) of new material. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Composer(s) of new material, Producer(s) & Engineer/Mixer(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Score Soundtrack for Video Games and Other Interactive Media
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes excellence in score soundtrack albums comprised predominantly of original scores created specifically for, or as a companion to, a current video game or other interactive media released within the qualification period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: At least two-thirds of the musical tracks for the album must have been used in the shipped game product (in-game, live action play or cinematics). Album releases adhere to timing guidelines where media product and soundtrack often are not in same eligibility year; Academy evaluates and adjusts accordingly. Eligible scores may include vocal coloring (not songs). Greater than 50% of the music on an otherwise eligible Video Game Soundtrack or Interactive Media soundtrack must be derived from new episodes or new programming released during the GRAMMY eligibility year (applies to DLC and seasonal expansions). Albums/songs released during current eligibility but whose visual media are released next year have options (enter now in other Categories, enter following year if not entered this year, or timing restrictions). Nominees are Composer(s); when more than one composer is listed, a minimum of 33% playing time is required. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Composer(s), Music Producer(s) & Engineer/Mixer(s). When more than one composer listed, the 33% playing time requirement applies to Music Producer(s) and Engineer(s)/Mixer(s). If a composer has a separate production team, the 33% playing time will apply to the Music Producer(s) and Engineer(s)/Mixer(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Song Written For Visual Media
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes excellence in songwriting for songs with melody and lyrics written specifically for and used in a motion picture, television show or series, video game, or other visual media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In this Category the film version may be entered even if different from version entered in other Categories. Albums/songs released during current eligibility period but belonging to visual media that will be released next eligibility period have options (enter current year in other Categories and forfeit Music For Visual Media eligibility next year; or enter following year if not entered this year). Songs from live concert films, live or filmed stage shows, musical/variety/reality television shows, musical documentaries focused on live performance or 'making of' works, and greatest hits/career retrospective songs are not eligible. Nominees are Songwriter(s) of new material. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Songwriter(s) of new material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Music Video
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes excellence in music videos (vocal or instrumental, any genre).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Music videos released online during the current eligibility year that are synchronous or predominantly synchronous to a commercially released recording are eligible if recognized by the artist and/or record label as the Official video for an individual track. Entrant must provide a streaming link via YouTube or Vimeo that remains active through the final voting period. Fan videos or re-edits not recognized by the artist/label are not eligible. Multitrack videos or visual albums are not eligible (those eligible in Best Music Film). Individual videos taken from video album packages that were eligible in a previous year are not eligible. A GRAMMY nomination in a performance Category does not affect eligibility of an eligibly released music video of the same recording in following years. Nominees are Artist(s) of newly recorded material, Video Director(s) & Video Producer(s). GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s) of newly recorded material, Video Director(s) & Video Producer(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Music Film
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes excellence in concert/performance films or music documentaries released for sale to the public for the first time or first appearing on television or online during the current eligibility year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes music-focused and individual music videos packaged as one cohesive visual album. Dramatic feature films and biopics are not eligible, though films with fictional elements may be eligible. Episodes from TV/online series, award shows, music competition shows, fictional music films, and musical biopics are not eligible as music films. Re-edited or repackaged old programs (more than five years from release), compilations of music videos by various artists, or any video films/promotional clips eligible in a previous eligibility year are not eligible. Adding bonus material to an otherwise ineligible music film does not make it eligible. Entrants must provide an active streaming link on a web platform or movie files on data disc/flash drive/DVD. A GRAMMY nomination does not affect eligibility of a music film in following years. Nominees are Artist(s) of newly recorded material, Video Director(s) & Video Producer(s) of over 50% of the total playing time of the music film. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to those nominees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Recording Package
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes excellence in the field of art and packaging for albums or singles (an Art Director’s Award).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Physical product in any configuration released for the first time during the eligibility year is eligible provided the packaging is predominantly new. Elements judged include package design, photography and/or graphic art of the entire package as well as any materials included. Previously released album art/packaging or reissues with only minimal new design elements are not eligible. An entry is eligible if the physical product release either meets the general distribution requirement or was made available for purchase solely via the artist’s or record company’s website, sold as a stand-alone product, and the sales link is available to all consumers (fan-club-only releases or subscription-series releases are not eligible). Nominees are Art Director(s). GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Art Director(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Album Cover
rubrics_metrics.description: An Art Director’s Award recognizing excellence in cover art for albums (albums only).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Elements judged include creativity, design, illustration, photography, and/or graphic art of the Album Cover. The Album Cover must be predominantly new; previously released cover art or reissues with minimal new cover art are not eligible. Eligible Album Covers can be from digital-only or streaming-only full-length releases as well as albums with physical configurations. Submission requires a high-resolution digital file of the album cover uploaded with the entry. Nominees are Art Director(s). GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Art Director(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Album Notes
rubrics_metrics.description: An Album Notes Writer’s Award recognizing excellence in album notes writing (albums only).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries must be one piece of original writing written for a specific album and released as part of that album for the first time during the eligibility year. In collaborations where more than one writer signed the same piece, eligibility discretion lies with the Academy. Eligible notes must be of literary excellence, originality and communicativeness and provide relevant exposition of recorded content. Each entry must be predominantly original writing. Books or booklets written for an album that are simultaneously released separately do qualify. Notes taken from previously issued books, articles or reviews are not eligible. Notes that are simply testimonials, transcripts of prior interviews not specifically created for the current release, brief letters of praise or congratulations are not eligible. Entry eligibility mirrors Recording Package rules for distribution (general distribution requirement or sold via artist/label website as a stand-alone product with sales link available to all consumers). Nominee is Album Notes Writer. GRAMMY statuette awarded to Album Notes Writer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Historical Album
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes excellence in newly created albums that feature historically significant material with new annotation and new packaging that provide important contributions to a fresh historical perspective and, where relevant, quality remastering and/or audio restoration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entries may include previously released recordings, alternate takes and/or previously unreleased recordings in any combination as well as old motion picture soundtracks, cast show albums and radio broadcasts. Straight reissues with no quality restoration/remastering and no changes in sequence or package are not eligible. Variant forms of previously GRAMMY-entered material are not eligible. This Category is not for new recordings of a historic nature or newly recorded re-creations of historic material—those should be entered in appropriate genre Categories. Up to three compilation producers can be entered for each album. Entry eligibility mirrors Recording Package rules for distribution (general distribution requirement or sold via artist/label website as a stand-alone product with sales link available to all consumers). Nominees are Compilation Producer(s), Restoration Engineer(s) & Mastering Engineer(s). GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Compilation Producer(s), Restoration Engineer(s) & Mastering Engineer(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Engineered Album, Non-Classical
rubrics_metrics.description: An Engineer’s Award recognizing excellence in engineering on a newly recorded non-classical album released for the first time during the current eligibility year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All eligibly credited recording engineers, mixers/mixing engineers and mastering engineers on the album are eligible. The basic criterion for judging is the finished product (the commercially released recording itself). Considerations include the overall mix, any unique techniques, the quality of sound, and the trueness of its reproduction; other factors (overdubbing, number of tracks, site/mode of recordings) are secondary. Nominees are Engineers (see P&E list for eligible credits) & Mastering Engineer. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Engineers & Mastering Engineer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Engineered Album, Classical
rubrics_metrics.description: An Engineer’s Award recognizing excellence in engineering on a newly recorded classical album released for the first time during the current eligibility year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All eligibly credited engineers on the album are eligible. Basic judging criterion is the finished product (commercially released recording). Consider the overall mix, any unique techniques, the quality of sound, and the trueness of its reproduction; other factors (overdubbing, track count, site/mode of recordings) are secondary. Any appraisal should be made on the basis of the total album itself. Nominees are Engineers (see P&E list for eligible credits) & Mastering Engineer. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Engineers & Mastering Engineer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Producer of the Year, Classical
rubrics_metrics.description: A Producer’s Award recognizing excellence in production of classical audio recordings for a producer whose body of work released during the eligibility year represents consistently outstanding creativity in recording production.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One album is required to qualify. The body of work covers up to nine projects (if more than nine submitted, the producer selects which nine to include). Minimum qualifications may be satisfied by combining solo production credits with team credits. A producer team must enter only projects worked on as a team. An individual cannot appear on the ballot as both an individual and as a member of a producer team. Only recordings released in the current eligibility year are eligible; tracks from albums released in previous years are not eligible even if released as a single in the current year. Reissued and historical recordings are not eligible. Nominees are Producer(s). GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Producer(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Immersive Audio Album
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes excellence in multichannel immersive audio recordings (albums).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible recordings must be commercially released for sale or streaming on a consumer format/configuration that provides an original immersive mix (not electronically repurposed) of four or more channels (DVD-Video, DVD-Audio, SACD, Blu-ray, Atmos, Auro-3D, immersive download, etc.). On releases with multiple distinct mixes, entrants choose which immersive mix they are entering; only one mix per album is eligible. Nominees are Immersive Audio Engineer(s)/Mixer(s), Immersive Audio Producer(s) & Immersive Audio Mastering Engineer(s), if applicable. If the album is released only in multichannel format, the Producer(s) and Engineer(s)/Mixer(s) receive an award. GRAMMY statuettes awarded accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Instrumental Composition
rubrics_metrics.description: A Composer’s Award recognizing excellence in instrumental composition (singles or tracks, instrumental only).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Open to any original non-classical composition without lyrics first released on a recording during the eligibility year, including original instrumental themes/main titles written for motion pictures or television, jazz compositions, and new composition backing spoken word entries. Instrumental compositions with 'vocal coloring' are eligible. Nominees are Composer(s) of new material. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Composer(s) of new material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Arrangement, Instrumental or A Cappella
rubrics_metrics.description: An Arranger’s Award recognizing excellence in instrumental arrangements on instrumental recordings or a cappella arrangements on vocal a cappella recordings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category is open to singles or tracks from albums released during the current eligibility year only. Compositions that are extended suites across several tracks are eligible as long as they are clearly conceived and released as such.
